nodes.text: 어서 오세요! 몇 분이세요?
nodes.pron: eoseo oseyo! myeot buniseyo?
nodes.trans: Welcome! How many people?

replies.trans: There are four of us. Do you have a table?

nodes.text: 창가 자리랑 바 자리 중에 어디가 좋으세요?
nodes.pron: changga jarirang ba jari junge eodiga joeuseyo?
nodes.trans: Would you like a window seat or a seat at the bar?

nodes.text: 네, 이쪽으로 앉으세요.
nodes.pron: ne, ijjogeuro anjeuseyo.
nodes.trans: Sure, please have a seat over here.

replies.trans: Could we sit outside, by any chance?

nodes.text: 죄송합니다. 지금 자리가 다 차서 십 분 정도 기다리셔야 하는데, 괜찮으세요?
nodes.pron: joesonghamnida. jigeum jariga da chaseo sip bun jeongdo gidarisyeoya haneunde, gwaenchaneuseyo?
nodes.trans: I'm sorry. We're full right now, so you'd need to wait about ten minutes. Is that okay?

nodes.text: 네, 오늘은 테라스도 열려 있어요. 이쪽으로 오세요.
nodes.pron: ne, oneureun teraseudo yeollyeo isseoyo. ijjogeuro oseyo.
nodes.trans: Sure, the terrace is open today. This way, please.

nodes.text: 오래 기다리셨죠? 자리 준비됐습니다. 이쪽으로 오세요.
nodes.pron: orae gidarisyeotjyo? jari junbidwaetseumnida. ijjogeuro oseyo.
nodes.trans: Thanks for waiting. Your table is ready. This way, please.

nodes.text: 여기 메뉴판이요. 음료 먼저 드릴까요?
nodes.pron: yeogi menyupaniyo. eumnyo meonjeo deurilkkayo?
nodes.trans: Here's the menu. Can I get you a drink first?

nodes.text: 수제 레모네이드랑 오늘의 파스타가 제일 인기 많아요.
nodes.pron: suje lemoneideurang oneurui paseutaga jeil ingi manayo.
nodes.trans: Our homemade lemonade and the pasta of the day are the most popular.

nodes.text: 주문하시겠어요?
nodes.pron: jumunhasigesseoyo?
nodes.trans: Are you ready to order?

replies.trans: I'll order in a little bit.

nodes.text: 네, 천천히 보시고 불러 주세요.
nodes.pron: ne, cheoncheonhi bosigo bulleo juseyo.
nodes.trans: Sure, take your time and call me when you're ready.

nodes.text: 네, 알겠습니다. 더 필요한 건 없으세요?
nodes.pron: ne, algetseumnida. deo piryohan geon eopseuseyo?
nodes.trans: Okay, got it. Do you need anything else?

replies.text: 빵 좀 더 주실 수 있어요?
replies.pron: ppang jom deo jusil su isseoyo?
replies.trans: Could I get some more bread?

nodes.text: 네, 바로 갖다 드릴게요.
nodes.pron: ne, baro gatda deurilgeyo.
nodes.trans: Sure, I'll bring it right away.

nodes.text: 주문하신 음식 나왔습니다. 맛있게 드세요!
nodes.pron: jumunhasin eumsik nawatseumnida. masitge deuseyo!
nodes.trans: Here's your order. Enjoy your meal!

replies.trans: Wow, it looks delicious! Thank you.

nodes.text: 식사는 괜찮으셨어요? 더 필요한 건 없으세요?
nodes.pron: siksaneun gwaenchaneusyeosseoyo? deo piryohan geon eopseuseyo?
nodes.trans: How was your meal? Do you need anything else?

replies.trans: Could I see the dessert menu?

replies.text: 남은 거 포장해 주실 수 있어요?
replies.pron: nameun geo pojanghae jusil su isseoyo?
replies.trans: Could you pack up the rest for me?

nodes.text: 여기 있어요. 초콜릿 케이크가 제일 맛있어요.
nodes.pron: yeogi isseoyo. chokollit keikeuga jeil masisseoyo.
nodes.trans: Here you go. The chocolate cake is the best.

replies.text: 그럼 그거 하나 주세요. 계산도 같이요.
replies.pron: geureom geugeo hana juseyo. gyesando gachiyo.
replies.trans: Then one of those, please. And the check, too.

nodes.text: 네, 포장 용기 갖다 드릴게요.
nodes.pron: ne, pojang yonggi gatda deurilgeyo.
nodes.trans: Sure, I'll bring you a to-go container.

replies.trans: Thank you. The check too, please.

nodes.text: 계산은 카드로 하시겠어요, 현금으로 하시겠어요?
nodes.pron: gyesaneun kadeuro hasigesseoyo, hyeongeumeuro hasigesseoyo?
nodes.trans: Will you pay by card or with cash?

nodes.text: 감사합니다. 영수증 여기 있습니다. 좋은 하루 보내세요!
nodes.pron: gamsahamnida. yeongsujeung yeogi itseumnida. joeun haru bonaeseyo!
nodes.trans: Thank you. Here's your receipt. Have a nice day!

nodes.text: 감사합니다. 거스름돈 여기 있습니다. 또 오세요!
nodes.pron: gamsahamnida. geoseureumdon yeogi itseumnida. tto oseyo!
nodes.trans: Thank you. Here's your change. Please come again!

nodes.text: 네, 알겠습니다. 다음에 꼭 다시 오세요!
nodes.pron: ne, algetseumnida. daeume kkok dasi oseyo!
nodes.trans: Okay, I understand. Please be sure to come back next time!
